title: Boston: Forty Years of Change
description:
An annual histogram traces Boston’s recorded crime, followed by an animated district map and monthly chart of the recent pattern. Source snapshot: July2026.

Data and reproduction: https://github.com/hadi-nayebi/cartography/tree/main/videos/boston-crime-context-2026-01

FBI index crimes and BPD crime-classified records use different definitions. Service records are excluded from crime totals; public sexual-assault records are absent from the newer file.

Music: retained Boston Stable Audio Open score.
